note: Justified exceptions to docs/helper-conventions.md, checked by tests/test_helper_conventions.py. Each entry names the script, the rule and the argument; keep the reason current.

exceptions.name: drafts
exceptions.why: The positional arguments are the draft documents being checked (files, or a folder of drafts), not a project directory.

exceptions.name: assessment
exceptions.why: The positional argument is the assessment document being checked, not a project directory.

exceptions.name: trace
exceptions.why: The positional argument is the NDJSON trace file being validated, not a project directory.

exceptions.name: files
exceptions.why: scan and extract take the documents the user named; they are inputs, not a project directory.

exceptions.name: candidates
exceptions.why: verify-candidates takes the candidate table file being checked.

exceptions.name: --root
exceptions.why: --root is the practice-profile store (default $AGENTIC_ENGINEERING_HOME or ~/.agentic-engineering), not the project; the project is --project.

resolve and brief report binding state through exit codes 3 (unbound), 4 (no profile root), 5 (bound to none) and 6 (document refused as crafted); six skills' practice-profile.md copies branch on them, so they keep their numbers.

exceptions.name: --repo
exceptions.why: url --repo is the GitHub owner/name that receives the issue, not a directory.
